Title: TC-01 Homepage shows navigation, promo banner and featured products
Description: Verify the homepage renders the brand header, category navigation, promo slider and featured product grid.

Expected Result: 'Silk Wrap Dress' is visible and exactly 6 'View Details' buttons are shown

Title: TC-02 Searching for a product shows matching results
Description: Verify keyword search returns only matching products.

Steps: Type 'denim' in the header search box and press Enter

Expected Result: 'Heritage Denim Jacket' is listed and 'Silk Wrap Dress' is not

Title: TC-03 Searching for an unknown term shows the empty state
Description: Verify search shows an empty state when nothing matches.

Steps: Type 'spaceship' in the header search box and press Enter

Title: TC-04 Men category lists only men's products
Description: Verify the Men category page filters products to men's items only.

Expected Result: 'Heritage Denim Jacket' is listed and 'Silk Wrap Dress' is not

Title: TC-05 Product details page shows price, reviews and selectable sizes
Description: Verify the PDP shows price, review count and size selection enabling Add to Cart.
Steps: From the homepage click 'View Details' on 'Silk Wrap Dress'
Expected Result: Product page opens with 'Silk Wrap Dress' H1
'Size: L' is shown as the selected size

Steps: Check the Add to Cart button

Title: TC-06 Adding a product updates the cart badge and cart contents
Description: Verify adding an item updates the header badge and the cart shows the item with correct totals.

Steps: Select size 'M' and click 'Add to Cart'
Click the cart icon in the header
Expected Result: 'Shopping Cart' page shows 'Silk Wrap Dress' with 'Size: M'
Subtotal is $189.99 and Total is $205.19 (incl. 8% tax)

Title: TC-07 Changing quantity recalculates totals and removing empties the cart
Description: Verify quantity changes recalculate subtotal/tax/total and removing the item empties the cart.
Steps: Add 'Essential Cotton Tee' size 'S' to the cart and open the cart
Expected Result: Cart shows the tee with quantity 1

Steps: Click the remove (trash) button on the item
Expected Result: 'Your cart is empty' heading is shown

Title: TC-08 Guest checkout places an order and shows confirmation
Description: Verify a guest can complete checkout end-to-end and see the order confirmation.
Preconditions: Cart is empty; user is not logged in
Steps: Add 'Leather Crossbody Bag' size 'One Size' to the cart and open the cart
Fill contact & shipping: jane.doe@example.com, Jane Doe, 100 Market Street, San Francisco, California, 94105, 4155550100
Fill payment: card 4242424242424242, name Jane Doe, expiry 12/30, CVV 123

Expected Result: 'Order Confirmed!' heading, 'Thank you for your purchase, Jane!' and an order number like #FS123456 are shown

Title: TC-09 Registered user can sign in and reach My Account
Description: Verify a registered user can log in and lands on the account page.

Steps: Enter email demo@fashionstack.com and password Demo@123

Expected Result: 'My Account' page is shown with demo@fashionstack.com displayed

Title: TC-10 Sign in with a wrong password shows an error
Description: Verify login is rejected with an error for an incorrect password.

Steps: Enter email demo@fashionstack.com and password WrongPass1!

Expected Result: 'Login Error' dialog shows 'Invalid email or password'
